text.text:
Background: When I first wanted to start my online retail business, I had an idea in my head but could not even understand where to begin. I had pictured what I wanted the products  to look like but only a very abstract thought of it. Not only was that a concern but how would I set up a website, get pictures for the product, edit those pictures to make them look good, set up QR codes ( which is a standard thing nowadays).

All that being said thats when I met Javi he took the guesswork out of everything, he made me feel confident in the venture. I had questions and concerns and Javi had the answers, he treated us with nothing but respect and professionalism. To sum up his services( because he can do everything label/brand/web design related) Javi took the idea and brought it to life! Here is an idea of how he works,  I once sketched a squiggle of an image for how I wanted the brand logo to look like, during one of our meetings. I assumed all I did was make everyone at the meeting confused, to my utmost surprise within the next day or two he had already made multiple drafts with variations of my idea  and was asking what I liked and didn't! He did not rush me, and made many changes to the logo until I was satisfied ! He then did the product photography, editing, brushing, polishing, and configured our website to near completion!

I really can't recommend enough working with Javi as he is nothing but a joy to work with. Regardless if this is your 1st time or 5th time trying to get a brand/business together he will work with you to meet your needs! I write this review because most business are just that, business's; Javi worked with me as a partner would, guiding me at times with the brand and always being receptive to my needs !  Take him up on a consultations and you'll see what Im talking about!

One of the biggest things they helped us with was malware removal from our website after it caused a number of issues for us.

We’re very happy with the partnership and plan to continue working with them. This is one of the greatest companies that I have ever worked with. I recommend them to anyone looking for a tech partner without reservation.

Man, these guys are good. They really know their stuff.

They helped me configure and clean up the DNS records for several of my domains, including setting up new email domains with Namecheap and Google Workspace. They made sure everything was configured correctly with SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and MX records so my emails would actually get delivered properly. I was also having problems receiving emails on one of my domains, and they found the issue and fixed it.

What I appreciate most is that they don't just make changes and disappear. They take the time to explain what they're doing in a way I can understand, double-check everything, and make sure there are no loose ends.

They really took the technical side off my shoulders and made sure everything worked without downtime or unnecessary headaches. Their customer service is top notch. They genuinely care about making sure you're happy, comfortable, and understand what's going on.

I highly recommend WP Tech Care to anyone who needs help with websites, domains, DNS, or business email. Very professional and reliable.

text.text:
I got a clean head so I know what you meant
Working with WP Tech Care on our WordPress and WooCommerce website has been a phenomenal experience.

Our website required much more than a basic setup. The customer experience, reliability, and presentation all needed to be polished and carefully managed. WP Tech Care took the time to understand our brand, customer journey, checkout process, refill workflow, and the custom functionality we needed.

They helped improve important areas of the site, including checkout, product pages, custom styling, backend workflows, and overall WooCommerce functionality. A lot of the project required custom solutions, and they were able to handle things that basic plugins could not accomplish on their own.

One thing that really stood out was how they handled issues involving a third-party software integration. Even though it was outside their direct responsibility, they created Loom recordings, documented bugs clearly, tested workflows, and helped move the process forward so nothing got lost.

Throughout onboarding, testing, and launch, WP Tech Care made themselves available. They joined Zoom calls, answered questions by phone, and explained technical issues in a way that was easy to understand. Whenever a challenge came up, we felt like we had a real partner helping us find a solution.

We also use WP Tech Care’s VPS hosting, which has been reliable and fast. For a WooCommerce site with many moving parts, speed, uptime, and dependable support are extremely important.

I would confidently recommend WP Tech Care to any business that needs a reliable WordPress or WooCommerce partner. They truly care about the outcome of the project and go above and beyond to get things done right.
